verdict.rationale: Slack ships an official, first-party Slack CLI for creating and managing Slack apps from the command line (e.g. `slack create` to scaffold Bolt projects), confirmed by a probe of its docs page and its use in the official quickstart. Its documented scope is app development, not operating a workspace or AI-agent-driven tasks. Missing for 10: evidence of CLI commands for workspace actions (messaging, search) usable by AI agents, documentation of AI-native or agent-oriented CLI features, independent or hands-on corroboration.
